name: How early should selections be made for a custom luxury home?

mainEntity.name: Which luxury home selections need to be made before construction starts?
mainEntity.text: Which luxury home selections need to be made before construction starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: In luxury construction, waiting too long to select finishes is one of the easiest ways to delay the project. Many premium items have long lead times or affect other trades, so they should be chosen during preconstruction whenever possible. That includes windows, exterior doors, cabinetry, tile, countertops, plumbing fixtures, appliances, lighting, and custom millwork. Some selections also affect electrical layouts, framing, waterproofing, or structural openings, so late decisions can create rework. Homeowners should build a selection schedule with the builder and designer and treat it as part of the project plan, not a separate design exercise. The more customized the home, the more important this becomes. Early decisions create pricing clarity, reduce substitutions, and keep the field team from waiting on answers.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-impact selections should be made early, especially windows, doors, cabinetry, stone, appliances, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and specialty millwork. These items often have long lead times and can affect structural or rough-in decisions. Early selection helps protect both the schedule and the budget.
